# Qisutu instance: qisutu
Alias /qisutu/static/ "/opt/qisutu/var/static/"

<Directory "/opt/qisutu/var/static/">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

ScriptAlias /qisutu/ "/opt/qisutu/bin/cgi-bin/"

<Directory "/opt/qisutu/bin/cgi-bin/">
    Options +ExecCGI -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    AddHandler cgi-script .pl
    DirectoryIndex index.pl
    CGIPassAuth On
    Require all granted
    SetEnv QISUTU_HOME /opt/qisutu
</Directory>

RedirectMatch 301 ^/qisutu$ /qisutu/

[Unit]
Description=Qisutu Automation and Mail Daemon (qisutu)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=qisutu
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/opt/qisutu
Environment=QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu
ExecStart=/usr/bin/perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl --sleep 3 --max-jobs 100
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=120
KillSignal=SIGTERM
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
